_: THE list of Jon's programs: the Apps menu (cool-tools/apps/) and the Cool tools front page are both built from this file by build.py. A new program = one entry here, its drawing in icons/make_icons.py, then python build.py --publish. 'path' is the program's folder in cool-tools; 'about' is the front page's line, 'short' the Apps menu's.

programs.name: Book reader
programs.short: Reads books aloud with AI voices
programs.about: Reads books and documents aloud with AI voices that run in your browser. Open a folder, files or a zip; several books, each with its own place.

programs.name: Cloud File Manager
programs.short: The shared folder on Jon's PC, from anywhere
programs.about: The file manager for the shared folder on Jon's PC: browse and download anywhere; with the PC's password, upload, move, copy, rename, delete (into a trash) and make folders private.

programs.name: Settings
programs.short: Sign-in, PC address, pinger and restart
programs.about: What all these programs share: the PC's sign-in for every page, the PC's address, a live pinger to the PC with Restart this PC, the devices signed in with recent sign-ins, and the PC's programs.

programs.name: HYPERWAVE Studio
programs.about: Sound-reactive visuals: 79 shapes, fractals and 4D forms that react to your microphone, PC audio, a song file or 18 built-in demo tracks.

programs.name: Plan Cutter
programs.short: Lay and cut sheets in a crooked room
programs.about: Draw a crooked room, lay sheet material on a ceiling or wall, cut it along the walls and get the numbers to mark on the real board.

programs.name: Screen Peek (test)
programs.short: A live look at Jon's PC screen
programs.about: Shows a live screenshot of Jon's PC, single or continuous. Password protected; works only while sharing is on at the PC.

programs.name: Simple Bench
programs.about: A 10-second device test: processor and graphics card scores, and which voice and settings the Book reader would suggest on this device.

programs.name: Browser app cache manager
programs.short: See and delete what these tools stored
programs.about: See and delete what these tools have stored in your browser: books, settings, downloaded voice files.
